scenario.zh: 大学篮球队希望为招募视频创建沉浸式球员集锦，展示三维投篮动作
scenario.en: College basketball team wants immersive player highlights for recruiting video showing 3D shooting form

instruction.zh: 确定体积捕捉的运动环境
instruction.en: Define the athletic environment for volumetric capture

label.zh: 室内球馆 - 多机位固定阵列

output.zh: 简报已更新为室内设置 | 建议12台相机覆盖半场 | 照明条件优化用于深度重建
output.en: Brief updated for indoor setup | 12-camera half-court coverage suggested | Lighting optimized for depth reconstruction

label.zh: 户外场地 - 移动捕捉装置

output.zh: 简报已调整为户外条件 | 移动装置配置8台相机 | 自然光补偿已启用深度估算
output.en: Brief adjusted for outdoor conditions | Mobile rig configured with 8 cameras | Natural light compensation enabled for depth estimation

instruction.zh: 选择无标记追踪分析的主要运动学数据
instruction.en: Choose primary kinematic data for markerless tracking analysis

label.zh: 全身生物力学 - 关节角度和释放点
label.en: Full-body biomechanics - joint angles and release point

output.zh: 简报包含23个关节追踪点 | 投篮释放高度和手臂伸展已标记 | 体积网格密度设为高
output.en: Brief includes 23 joint tracking points | Shot release height and arm extension marked | Volumetric mesh density set to high

output.zh: 简报侧重于球的飞行路径 | 球员位置映射到三维场地坐标 | 旋转和弧线数据已启用
output.en: Brief focuses on ball flight path | Player position mapped to 3D court coordinates | Spin and arc data enabled

instruction.zh: 选择最能展示运动分析的三维导航路径
instruction.en: Select 3D navigation path that best showcases athletic analysis

label.zh: 环绕轨道 - 围绕球员旋转

output.zh: 故事板显示180度弧形环绕 | 从正面开始慢速旋转至侧面投篮形态 | 时间重映射用于关键动作
output.en: Storyboard shows 180-degree arc around player | Slow rotation from front to side shooting form | Time remapping for key motion

label.zh: 冻结时刻 - 静态球员带虚拟相机移动
label.en: Freeze moment - static player with virtual camera movement

output.zh: 故事板展示投篮顶点冻结 | 相机向上推进查看释放角度 | 体积网格保持时间切片供检查
output.en: Storyboard shows shot apex freeze | Camera push upward to examine release angle | Volumetric mesh holds time-slice for inspection

instruction.zh: 确认最终的体积视频捕捉计划
instruction.en: Confirm final volumetric video capture plan

output.zh: 简报已准备完成 | 包含相机阵列布局、追踪参数和视角序列 | 可下载供现场团队使用
output.en: Brief ready | Includes camera array layout, tracking parameters, and viewpoint sequence | Available for download by field team

output.zh: 简报已修改网格设置 | 更高保真度用于面部细节但需更多处理时间 | 重建质量与速度权衡已记录
output.en: Brief modified with mesh settings | Higher fidelity for facial detail but longer processing time | Quality-speed tradeoff documented

takeaway.zh: 体积视频捕捉将二维拍摄转换为完全可导航的三维空间，适用于体育分析和沉浸式内容
takeaway.en: Volumetric capture transforms 2D footage into fully navigable 3D space for sports analysis and immersive content

initial.zh: 球员投篮集锦 | 重点：三步上篮和跳投 | 角度：360度旋转视角 | 时长：45秒
initial.en: Player shooting highlights | Focus: layups and jump shots | Angles: 360 rotation | Duration: 45s
